sections.shortTitle: Acceding State Property Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXVIII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXVIII OF
1996
ACCEDING STATE (PROPERTY) (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the Acceding
State (Property) Order, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
16th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96-Pub., dated 16-12-1996.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961 (P.O. No. 12 of 1961), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 85! of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Acceding State (Property) (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
